tasks.name: ספירת חברי {9,12,14}
tasks.note: Counts only elements belonging to an arbitrary hidden set {9,12,14}.

tasks.name: סכום שארית 1 ב-3
tasks.note: Sums (mod 16) only elements with x%3==1, i.e. 10 and 13.

tasks.name: סכום בטווח 10..13
tasks.note: Sums (mod 16) only elements inside the hidden window 10..13.

tasks.name: מקסימום מתוך {8,11,13}
tasks.note: Max over only the hidden set {8,11,13}, 0 when none present.

tasks.name: מינימום מתוך {11,12,14}
tasks.note: Min over only the hidden set {11,12,14}, 0 when none present.

tasks.name: סכום עם ביט 1 דלוק
tasks.note: Sums (mod 16) only elements whose bit 1 is set (10,11,14,15), a bitwise hidden filter.

tasks.name: XOR של {9,10,13}
tasks.note: XOR-folds only the elements in the hidden set {9,10,13}.

tasks.name: שלוש פעמים ספירת קצוות
tasks.note: Counts the extreme values 8 and 15 only and multiplies the count by 3.

tasks.name: סכום שארית 1 ב-4 ועוד 1
tasks.note: Sums elements with x%4==1 (9,13), adds 1, reduces mod 16.

tasks.name: הראשון שמתחלק ב-5
tasks.src: l=>{ for(const x of l){ if(x%5===0) return x; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Returns the first element in list order divisible by 5 (10 or 15), else 0.

tasks.name: הפרש ספירות שתי קבוצות
tasks.note: Count of {9,11,12} minus count of {13,14}, mod 16 (two hidden sets with opposite signs).
